full_details: You left the house with the blessing already given and the books still on the shelf. At the Bull the ostler brought the bay bespoken on the seventeenth. You paid nothing for him this morning. You left by Ludgate and the Strand, and at Charing Cross you did not turn up for the straight road. The memo is eight words. That is all of the reason the day holds. Uxbridge by ten, Beaconsfield at one, a bright cold day, the beech-buds still shut. The bay argued every mile. You were sore from Beaconsfield and said so to nobody. High Wycombe, thirty-four miles, by half past three: the Catherine Wheel, a shared bed, pottage and a herring. Before the boots came off you checked the parcels, and the evening memo is the list of what you should have packed where a hand could reach it.
one_sentence: You took the bay at first light, said eight words, and checked the parcels before you slept at the Catherine Wheel.
title: Took the bay at first light, and said eight words
